_doc: Radiant quest archetypes (Daggerfall-style), drawn by com.nirncraft.quest.story.RadiantTemplates for townsfolk outside Skyrim. Args: %1$s direction, %2$s site, %3$s gold, %4$s named target, %5$s region, %6$s destination town. Texts are exported to lang by tools/quest_lang.js.

templates.title: Vermin at %2$s
templates.desc: Something has moved into the storehouses at %2$s, %1$s of here, and the owner would pay %3$s gold to have it moved out again.
templates.pitch: Our stores at %2$s, %1$s of here. Something's nesting in them, and the last man I sent came back without his boots. %3$s gold if you clear them out.

steps.text: Tell the owner the stores are clear

templates.title: The Beast Called %4$s
templates.desc: A beast the locals call %4$s has made its lair at %2$s, %1$s of here. Its head is worth %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: They call it %4$s. It lairs at %2$s, %1$s of here, and it has taken two hunters and a mule this month. Bring it down and the reward is %3$s gold.

templates.title: Something Takes the Herd
templates.desc: A beast has been raiding the herds %1$s of here, near %2$s. The herders will pay %3$s gold to see it dead.
templates.pitch: Every third night another animal is gone and the fence is just... open. Tracks lead %1$s, towards %2$s. %3$s gold, from all of us.

steps.text: Tell the herders their animals are safe

templates.title: The Master of %2$s
templates.desc: The dead are walking out of %2$s, %1$s of here. Somebody inside is calling them up, and they call themselves %4$s.
templates.pitch: Graves dug up from below. Corpses on the road at dawn, all walking the same way: %1$s, to %2$s. The one who calls them signs their letters %4$s. %3$s gold to end it.

steps.text: Cut through the risen dead of %2$s

templates.title: The House That Weeps
templates.desc: An old homestead at %2$s, %1$s of here, has a tenant who died years ago. The family wants to move back in. They will pay %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: My grandmother's house at %2$s, %1$s of here. Nobody's lived there since the fever. At night the doors bang and someone sings in the cellar. Sit with it a while, and then... make it stop. %3$s gold.

steps.text: Go to the old house at %2$s
Lay the restless spirits to rest
Tell the family the house is quiet

templates.title: The Ancestor in the Crypt
templates.desc: A noble family fears their ancestor %4$s has risen in the family crypt at %2$s, %1$s of here. They want it done quietly, for %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: This is delicate. My house's founder, %4$s, was buried at %2$s with honours. Now the crypt door stands open at dawn and the dogs won't go near it. End this. Quietly. %3$s gold.

steps.text: Tell the family it is done, and nothing more

templates.title: A Tear Near %2$s
templates.desc: Something has torn open near %2$s, %1$s of here, and daedra are walking out of it. %3$s gold to close it.
templates.pitch: The air near %2$s, %1$s of here, smells of brimstone and burnt hair. People have seen horned things in the fields. If you can send them back, %3$s gold, and my eternal gratitude, which is worth less.

steps.text: Fight the daedra at the breach
Slay %4$s, who holds the breach open
Report that the breach has closed

templates.title: The Thing at %2$s
templates.desc: A collector heard that something old and valuable lies in %2$s, %1$s of here. They will pay %3$s gold for it.
templates.pitch: I collect. Rumor says something rather special lies in %2$s, %1$s of here, and that nobody who went for it came back to argue about the price. %3$s gold if you bring it to me.

steps.text: Bring the relic to the collector

templates.title: Gone Missing
templates.desc: %4$s went out %1$s of here, towards %2$s, and never came back. Their family will pay %3$s gold to know what happened.
templates.pitch: %4$s went out %1$s, towards %2$s, three days ago. Said it was just for the afternoon. Please. Find them. %3$s gold is all we have.

templates.title: Sealed for %6$s
templates.desc: A sealed letter must reach %6$s, and the sender is paying %3$s gold for speed and discretion.
templates.pitch: This letter goes to %6$s, and it goes today. Don't open it. Don't lose it. Don't let anyone see you hand it over. %3$s gold, paid there.

templates.title: The Relic Must Move
templates.desc: The temple's relic must be moved to %6$s before raiders take it. They will try anyway. %3$s gold for the escort.
templates.pitch: Raiders have hit our shrine twice for the relic we keep. It must go to %6$s, where the walls are thicker. They'll be waiting on the road. %3$s gold.

steps.text: Break the ambush on the road
Bring the relic to the temple in %6$s

templates.title: Roots and Caps
templates.desc: An apothecary needs rare reagents that only grow near %2$s, %1$s of here. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: The rarest things grow where the worst things nest. %2$s, %1$s of here. Bring me a full bundle and I'll pay %3$s gold. Wear gloves.

steps.text: Bring the reagents to the apothecary

templates.title: The Profane Shrine
templates.desc: A cult has made a shrine of %2$s, %1$s of here. Their leader, %4$s, must fall. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: There are candles in %2$s again, %1$s of here, and chanting at night. The cult's leader calls himself %4$s. The temple wants it ended and will pay %3$s gold.

steps.text: Tell the temple the shrine is purged

templates.title: Taken in the Night
templates.desc: Thieves took a family heirloom and fled %1$s, towards %2$s. Its owner will pay %3$s gold for its return.
templates.pitch: They came through the window and took the one thing that mattered. My mother's. They're holed up at %2$s, %1$s of here; everyone knows it and nobody does anything. %3$s gold if you do.

steps.text: Take the heirloom back from the thieves at %2$s

templates.title: Ransom
templates.desc: A gang led by %4$s took someone and holds them at %2$s, %1$s of here, for ransom. The family would rather pay me %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: A note under the door. They want everything we have, and they'll still do what they want. The gang's at %2$s, %1$s of here; their leader is %4$s. %3$s gold to bring our child home instead.

steps.text: Tell the family their child is coming home

templates.title: The Turncoat
templates.desc: %4$s sold out their own and fled %1$s of here, to %2$s. Someone wants that debt settled, for %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: %4$s rode with us for six years and sold us for a purse. They're hiding at %2$s, %1$s of here. I don't want them back. I want them done. %3$s gold.

steps.text: Find %4$s at %2$s and settle the debt
Tell your client it is done

templates.title: The Long Watch
templates.desc: Someone needs a guard at %2$s, %1$s of here, through a dangerous night. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: I need someone at %2$s, %1$s of here, until the work is done, and I need them awake. There will be visitors. You'll know them because they'll be trying to kill you. %3$s gold.

templates.title: It Got Out
templates.desc: A mage's experiment, %4$s, broke its bindings and fled %1$s, towards %2$s. Quietly destroy it for %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: A small matter of containment. My... project, %4$s, slipped its circle and went %1$s, to %2$s. Destroy it before the guard hears about this. %3$s gold, and you never met me.

templates.title: A Reading at %2$s
templates.desc: A scholar needs an observation taken at %2$s, %1$s of here, over a few hours. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: The ley-lines bend at %2$s, %1$s of here, and I need a reading taken there over a few hours. I would go myself, but I have a strong preference for not being eaten. %3$s gold.

templates.title: The Wizard of %2$s
templates.desc: %4$s, a mage gone rogue, has holed up in %2$s, %1$s of here, and defies the crown. %3$s gold for their end.
templates.pitch: %4$s was brilliant once. Now they've taken %2$s, %1$s of here, and the crown's letters come back burned. The guild washes its hands. We don't. %3$s gold.

templates.title: What the Sea Gave Back
templates.desc: A merchant's strongbox lies with a wreck near %2$s, %1$s of here, and scavengers have got there first. %3$s gold for the box.
templates.pitch: My ship went down off %2$s, %1$s of here. The crew's gone; the strongbox isn't, and the scavengers know it. %3$s gold for the box, unopened.

templates.title: A Fresh Heart
templates.desc: Someone needs the heart of a daedra, fresh. One walks near %2$s, %1$s of here. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: Don't ask what it's for. A daedra has been seen at %2$s, %1$s of here. Its heart, still warm, is worth %3$s gold to me. Cold, it's worth nothing.

steps.text: Bring the heart while it's warm

templates.title: A Favour for the Sisters
templates.desc: A coven of witches asked a favour: witch-hunters are camped at %2$s, %1$s of here. In return, %3$s gold and the sisters' goodwill.
templates.pitch: The sisters remember who helps them. Witch-hunters have made camp at %2$s, %1$s of here, with nets and fire. Send them home, or wherever. %3$s gold, and a door that will open for you later.

templates.title: The Elder of %2$s
templates.desc: An ancient vampire, %4$s, has taken %2$s, %1$s of here, as a court. %3$s gold to destroy it.
templates.pitch: Families vanish around %2$s, %1$s of here, and come back pale and polite. The thing at the heart of it is %4$s, older than the road you came on. %3$s gold. Bring garlic. Bring more than garlic.

templates.title: The Warband of %4$s
templates.desc: An orc warband under %4$s camps at %2$s, %1$s of here, and has been taking tolls in blood. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: Mercenaries, they say. Mercenaries who stopped waiting for contracts. %4$s leads them from %2$s, %1$s of here. %3$s gold, and the road open again.

templates.title: Chains in the Reeds
templates.desc: Slavers led by %4$s took hatchlings from a village and camp at %2$s, %1$s of here. %3$s gold, and the village's thanks.
templates.pitch: The warm-skins came in boats with nets. They have little ones from our village at %2$s, %1$s of here. Their leader is %4$s. This one cannot pay much, only %3$s gold. And the Hist's memory.

steps.text: Tell the village the little ones are free

templates.title: Sugar and Smoke
templates.desc: A skooma den at %2$s, %1$s of here, is cooking the moon-sugar wrong and selling it cheap. Its master is %4$s. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: Moon-sugar is sacred. What %4$s cooks at %2$s, %1$s of here, is not. Young ones go in and come out empty. %3$s gold to end the den, and this one will not ask how.
names: the Candy Man of the Dunes

steps.text: Tell the giver the den is gone

templates.title: Axes in the Green
templates.desc: Someone is cutting living wood at %2$s, %1$s of here. The Green Pact demands an answer. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: Fresh sap on the ground at %2$s, %1$s of here. Living wood, cut by iron. Whoever did it is still there, and the Green remembers. %3$s gold, and the forest's favour.

steps.text: Tell the giver the cutting has stopped

templates.title: Sails from the South
templates.desc: Maormer raiders under %4$s landed at %2$s, %1$s of here. %3$s gold to throw them back into the sea.
templates.pitch: Serpent-prowed boats on the beach at %2$s, %1$s of here. Sea elves, and a captain they call %4$s. The garrison is days away. You are not. %3$s gold.

steps.text: Fight the raiders on the beach at %2$s

templates.title: Grave Goods
templates.desc: Robbers broke into the family tomb at %2$s, %1$s of here, and took the ancestors' urn. %3$s gold, and the family's honour restored.
templates.pitch: Outlanders. In our tomb at %2$s, %1$s of here. They took an urn. Do you understand? They took a grandmother. Bring her back and %3$s gold is yours, with the ancestors' blessing.

steps.text: Return the ancestor to her family

templates.title: The Ledger
templates.desc: A smuggling ring keeps its books at %2$s, %1$s of here. Someone wants the ledger, and will pay %3$s gold for it.
templates.pitch: Every smuggler on this coast pays someone, and someone writes it down. That book is at %2$s, %1$s of here. Bring it to me before anyone burns it. %3$s gold.

templates.title: The Closed Eye
templates.desc: A forbidden book is kept at %2$s, %1$s of here, by people who read it too often. Someone wants it out of their hands. %3$s gold.
templates.pitch: There is a book at %2$s, %1$s of here, with a clasp like a closed eye. The people guarding it have started to look like it. Take it from them. Do not read it. %3$s gold.

templates.title: Blood for the Chief
templates.desc: The stronghold will hear me out once I bring down %4$s, who hunts near %2$s, %1$s of here. %3$s gold besides.
templates.pitch: You want the chief's ear? Earn it. %4$s hunts near %2$s, %1$s of here. Bring it down with your own hands and the chief will drink with you. %3$s gold from the forge-wife, too.

steps.text: Tell the stronghold of your kill
